title: ctenitis inaequalifolia
intro: Ctenitis inaequalifolia, commonly known as Kunze's fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Kunze's fern are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and facilitate the removal of mucus from the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of Kunze's fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
